svg.title: Route A versus Route B
svg.desc: Route A, the expressway, takes 20 minutes with exposure score 82. Route B, the green canopy corridor, takes 24 minutes with exposure score 42.

svg.text: Standard GPS picks the fastest road. AirGuard also prices what you breathe on the way.
